stem.text: Several steps are involved in the synthesis of 2-hydroxypropanoic acid from ethanol.
Which statements concerning this synthesis are correct?

items: The chain length can be increased during a step involving reaction between $\text{HCN}$ and an aldehyde.
The carboxyl group can be made by hydrolysis of a nitrile by boiling with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ and then acidifying.
The ethanol should be first oxidised by heating it under reflux with an excess of acidified potassium dichromate(VI).
